component.name: Secure PIN Settings
component.summary: Configure TPM 2.0 PIN authentication for Linux

description.p: Secure PIN for Linux provides a Windows Hello–style, hardware-backed PIN authentication system using TPM 2.0. It integrates with PAM for login, lock screen, sudo, and desktop keyring auto-unlock.

ul.li: Hardware-backed security: PIN master encryption keys sealed in TPM 2.0
Dictionary Attack protection: Hardware anti-hammering lockout
Unified authentication: Single prompt for PIN or system password
Desktop keyring auto-unlock: Automatically unlock GNOME Keyring and KWallet
Configurable PIN complexity policy (digits-only, custom lengths)

description.p: Release 1.0.3: Flatpak packaging support with GNOME 50 runtime, sandbox host portal integration, and project documentation updates.
Release 1.0.2: Security hardening, PAM safety enhancements, udev permissions, and GNOME Shell 51 support.
Release 1.0.1: Security hardening and hardware detection improvements.
Initial release of Secure PIN for Linux.
